ios.desc:
On-Device AI puts chat, listening, transcription, notes, and research in one private app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. Your data stays on your device.

Download a model once and keep working on a plane, on the subway, or without a signal. Chats, documents, recordings, and notes stay on your device. Online providers and web features are optional and work only after you enable them.

ONE APP, YOUR WAY
Open every workspace from a customizable Menu. Keep favorites under Pinned and everything else close by under Available.

AI CHAT
Chat with local or cloud models.
• Run local models from families such as Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Mistral, or connect your own provider account
• Browse, download, and manage models that fit your device, including ones for text, vision, reasoning, and tools
• Drop in documents, images, and scanned PDFs; approve private on-device OCR only when a PDF needs it
• Fork any conversation and compare several models on the same prompt
• Let the model use tools for calculations, web requests, documents, Calendar, and Reminders, and review proposed changes before they apply
• Create reusable Agent Profiles, then add AI Skills, MCP servers, and tools from one clearer Agent Workflows setup
• Keep facts you repeat often in Global Memory

LISTEN LIBRARY AND RSS FEEDS
Read less, listen more.
• Turn PDFs, Markdown, plain text, web articles, and scanned books into a listening queue
• Scan photographed pages, correct the OCR the app runs on device, and keep each page with its spoken text
• Follow sites through RSS, Atom, and JSON feeds, then send articles to Up Next
• Choose Apple voices or local neural voices, follow along in the reader, and set a sleep timer

VOICE NOTE, VOICE TYPING, AND TEXT TO SPEECH
Speak instead of typing, and listen instead of reading.
• Record and transcribe meetings, lectures, interviews, and quick ideas
• Dictate with Voice Typing on Mac or the voice keyboard on iPhone and iPad
• Transcribe with Apple Speech, Whisper, Parakeet, Nemotron, Qwen3-ASR, MOSS, and other engines
• Turn text, or text captured from a photo, into audio with Apple voices, Kokoro, Supertonic, VoxCPM2, IndexTTS2, and other engines
• Export transcripts as text, subtitles, or Markdown

AI SEARCH AND AI BROWSER
Research with a second pair of hands.
• Search the web in a conversation and let the model read the results for you
• Browse with tabs, profiles, history, and downloads, then ask your model to read, assist, or act on the page
• Hand
